key_insight: Fine-tuned MACE simulations reveal a shift from localized, nonlinear Li⁺ dynamics below 500 K to contrasting behavior near 800 K, with strong competition between Li⁺ and framework dynamics at 500–700 K.
engineering_relevance: Understanding temperature-dependent coupling between mobile ions and the lattice can inform solid-electrolyte design and modeling.
method: Run molecular dynamics with a fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential.
Apply essential dynamics analysis to eigenspectra and low-dimensional trajectory embeddings.
Use Langevin dynamics to test how damping framework motion affects Li⁺ dynamics.
evidence_signal: Eigenspectra and trajectory embeddings show nonmonotonic temperature dependence at 500–700 K, supported by framework-damping simulations.
watch_item: The abstract does not report quantitative potential-validation errors or conductivity benchmarks, limiting assessment of predictive accuracy.
paper_title: Temperature-Dependent Ion Dynamics in Argyrodite Superionic Conductor Li$_{6}$PS$_{5}$Cl with Fine-Tuned MACE Foundation Model
